This is the homework 3!

#Problem 1
Load the NOAA data
```{r}
library(p8105.datasets)
data("ny_noaa")
```

Check the number of rows and columns.
Check first 5 row of dataset to look variables.
```{r}
nrow(ny_noaa)
ncol(ny_noaa)
head(ny_noaa)
```
Check missing values in each variable
```{r}
colSums(is.na(ny_noaa))
```
The ny_noaa dataset contains 2,595,176 observations and 7 variables.

The dataset includes station ID (id), date (date), precipitation (prcp), snowfall (snow), snow depth (snwd), maximum temperature (tmax), and minimum temperature (tmin).Each row represents a weather observation for a station on a specific date.

There are no missing values in id or date.
Missing data are present in the weather variables, with 145,838 missing values in prcp, 381,221 in snow, 591,786 in snwd, 1,134,358 in tmax, and 1,134,420 in tmin.

Missing data are big issue in this dataset, especially for the temperature.
